text_blocks.snippet:
For an undergraduate focus in power systems and electric grid engineering in North Carolina, North Carolina State University (NC State) in Raleigh is the premier choice, backed by UNC Charlotte

as a strong secondary option with a dedicated power concentration.
snippet_highlighted_words: North Carolina State University (NC State) in Raleigh

list.snippet:
North Carolina State University (NC State): Offers a Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering with dedicated formal concentrations in Power Systems and Renewable Electric Energy Systems (REES)
. Home to major research initiatives like the FREEDM Systems Center, providing unmatched undergraduate research and networking with major utilities like Duke Energy.

UNC Charlotte: Offers a focused Power and Energy Systems Concentration inside its Electrical Engineering undergraduate program, featuring specialized coursework in power system analysis and an intensive two-semester senior design project.

table: BS in Electrical Engineering – Power Systems or Renewable Electric Energy Systems (REES)
Access to cutting-edge smart grid research centers, high industry recruitment, and extensive power electronics courses.
BS in Electrical Engineering – Power and Energy Systems
Practical, hands-on regional utility focus with sequential Power System Analysis I & II and dedicated capstone design.
